description: This file defines a custom bottom sheet dialog fragment for an Android application, including UI setup, action management, and builder pattern for configuration.

classes.name: BottomSheet
classes.description: A custom bottom sheet dialog fragment with configurable actions and header.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Action
classes.description: Parcelable class representing an action in the bottom sheet with title, icon, and click behavior.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Builder
classes.description: Builder class to construct a list of actions for the BottomSheet.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the view hierarchy for the bottom sheet, including header and action items.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the bottom sheet behavior upon view creation, setting it to expanded state.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to create and display a BottomSheet with specified header and actions.

methods.name: action (Builder)
methods.description: Adds an action with resource ID as title to the builder if condition is true.

methods.name: action (Builder)
methods.description: Adds an action with string title to the builder if condition is true.
